- **Practical retrieval** — keyword search by default, with English prefix m"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"atching and live results; optional OpenAI-compatible or Ollama embeddings enable hybrid and semantic"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" modes.
- **Conversation access switch** — model access is off by default. When off, every `obsidian"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"_*` Agent tool is denied; your own search and note browsing keep working.
- **Safe writes** — the mo"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"del can only propose a create or append. Nothing is written until you approve; writes are backed up "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"and can be undone. There are no delete, move, rename, or overwrite tools.

- A local Obsidian vault"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Install source"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness can install the plugin from either a GitHub repository or an npm package:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **GitHub repository**: `https://github.com/spark-ai-boy/dsh-obsidian-bridge`
- **npm package**: `d"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ry**: `https://github.com/spark-ai-boy/dsh-obsidian-bridge`
- **npm package**: `dsh-obsidian-bridge`"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Steps"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. Open **Plugins** in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
2. Choose **Add plugin** → **Install third-part"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"y plugin**.
3. Enter either the **GitHub repository URL** or the **npm package name** above, install"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" it, then click **Enable**.
4. Open **Obsidian Vault Studio** in the sidebar."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## First run"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. Open **Settings**, choose your vault path, and click **Save**.
2. Click **Rebuild index**. The da"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"shboard and search become available once the first index completes.
3. Retrieval mode defaults to **"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"Keyword**; no extra setup is needed.
4. For semantic or hybrid search, enter an OpenAI-compatible or"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" Ollama embedding endpoint, model, and dimensions in Settings. Click **Test connection**, save, then"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" rebuild the index.
5. The **Allow vault context in conversations** switch on the dashboard is off b"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"y default. Turn it on when you want the Agent to use the vault; when off, every `obsidian_*` tool ca"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"rn it on when you want the Agent to use the vault; when off, every `obsidian_*` tool call is denied."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Dashboard"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The home page shows note, word, tag, 7-day update, and chunk counts; a 365-day heatmap; a 14-day act"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ivity curve; Agent call counters; recent notes; and tag distribution."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Search"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Type a keyword or prefix on the **Search** page; results update as you type. 2. The page shows the target path and a diff.
3. Noth"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ing is written until you approve.
4. Writes can be undone and are backed up."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Use in a conversation"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"1. Turn on **Allow vault context in conversations** on the dashboard.

- "Find my notes about RAG and cite the sources."

3. Only passages actually retrieved or read enter the conversation; the wh"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"ole vault is never injected automatically.
4. Turn the access switch off when you no longer need it."},{"id":"p27s5","text":" Later tool calls will be denied."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Agent tools"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| `obsidian_search` | Search note passages by mode, folder, or tag |

| `obsidian_list_notes` | List or filter notes |
| `obsidian_stats` | Read index, stati"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"stics, and workspace status |
| `obsidian_propose_write` | Create a create/append proposal without w"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"riting |
| `obsidian_apply_write` | Apply a proposal after your approval |
| `obsidian_undo_write` |"},{"id":"p30s5","text":" Undo a write from this session |
| `obsidian_index_status` | Check indexing and embedding progress "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"Undo a write from this session |
| `obsidian_index_status` | Check indexing and embedding progress |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The plugin has no delete, move, rename, or overwrite tools."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Privacy and safety"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- The index, vectors, settings, and usage counters are local. The plugin contains no telemetry and d"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"oes not upload the vault.
- When **Allow vault context in conversations** is off, every `obsidian_*`"},{"id":"p33s3","text":" Agent tool is denied before execution. Vault Studio's own search and browsing remain available.
- T"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"he system prompt tells the model to report Obsidian tool failures and never bypass Vault Studio or t"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"he access switch through generic file tools.
- The access switch only gates `obsidian_*` tools. For "},{"id":"p33s6","text":"a hard boundary, also check DeepSeek Harness workspace/sandbox permissions so generic `read`, `grep`"},{"id":"p33s7","text":", and `bash` cannot reach the vault path.
- Writes require approval, keep backups, and can be undone"},{"id":"p33s8","text":". The plugin never deletes or overwrites notes automatically."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
